purpose: Andrea concentrating on his laptop during the audience shortcut practice.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent character illustration for the right-hand side of an educational presentation slide.
Primary request: Andrea, the same university student shown in the reference image, seated behind a laptop computer and very concentrated on his work.
Input image 1: character identity and illustration-style reference only. Preserve his recognizable youthful face, thick tousled curly brown hair, brown eyes, small facial moles, dark teal zip hoodie and off-white T-shirt. This character is named Andrea in the presentation.
Style/medium: match the reference's refined comic ink outlines, warm skin, carefully drawn hair, crisp cel shading and softly textured illustrated rendering.
Pose/expression: three-quarter view from the front, slightly leaning toward the laptop, eyebrows subtly drawn together, eyes focused intently down at the computer screen, relaxed closed mouth. Attentive, absorbed and thoughtful, not angry or anxious. Both hands naturally positioned typing on the keyboard. We can see his entire head, shoulders and forearms above and behind the laptop.
Composition/framing: a compact square illustration, isolated as one clean cutout. Face is prominent in the upper half. A simple unbranded dark gray laptop sits in the foreground at the lower third, its screen back facing the viewer at a slight angle. Show the full laptop and both hands without clipping; small safe margins around all edges. Use believable perspective and anatomy.
Lighting/mood: soft directional light with a subtle screen reflection on the face, maintaining the reference colors.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with actual alpha; opaque fills inside the person and computer. No room, scenery, floor, extra objects, extra people, book, floating symbols, speech bubbles, sweat drops, text, logos, watermarks, halo or ambient glow behind the subject.
